 Woman linked to Eva Longoria, Tony Parker affair scandal had staggering amount of alcohol in her system at time of suicide: autopsy 
 By 
 Sarah Jones and 
 Lucas Widman 
 Published 
 Nov. 4, 2026, 3:25 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Erin Benavides — the woman once accused of having an emotional affair with Eva Longoria’s ex-husband Tony Parker — had a staggering amount of alcohol in her system when she died by suicide.
 The former prosecutor’s autopsy and toxicology report, which was released and obtained by Page Six on Wednesday, showed Benavides’ blood alcohol concentration was 0.401% — more than five times the legal limit.
 Isopropanol and acetone were also found in Benavides’ system.
 6 
 Erin Benavides (pictured above), who was once accused of having an emotional affair with NBA player Tony Parker, had a blood alcohol concentration of 0.401% following her death, officials said Wednesday. That’s more than five times the legal limit. Christina Mitchell / Facebook 
 6 
 Benavides denied the allegations made against her at the time when Parker was married to actress Eva Longoria. Parker and Eva Longoria are shown above at Eve Nightclub in Las Vegas, Nevada, in May 2010. WireImage

 As Page Six previously reported, the Nueces County Medical Examiner’s Office confirmed Benavides, 54, died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Her death was ruled a suicide .
 According to the autopsy and toxicology report, Benavides had a history of making suicidal comments, including text messages sent to family members.
 Benavides was found dead inside her Port Aransas, Texas, home on Oct. 14. Police were called to the residence after her husband’s friend received a concerning text message from Benavides.
 Responding officers forced their way into Benavides’ home, where they discovered her body. Three firearms and multiple bullets were documented at the scene.

 Benavides (pictured above) was married to Parker’s teammate Brent Barry at the time. Their marriage ended in divorce. Pure Flats / Facebook

 The Port Aransas Police Department previously stated no foul play was suspected, but the investigation was ongoing.
 Benavides was put in the spotlight in 2010 when she was accused of having an emotional affair with the Parker, who was married to Longoria at the time.
 Benavides was married to Parker’s San Antonio Spurs teammate Brent Barry, and denied the affair allegations . Parker and Barry played together from 2004 to 2008.
 Despite the denial, both couples ended their marriages .
 The “Desperate Housewives” actress filed for divorce from the NBA champion in November 2010.
 6 
 Parker, left, and Barry, right, hold trophies during the San Antonio Spurs championship parade in San Antonio, Texas, on Sunday, June 17, 2007. NBAE via Getty Images 
 6 
 Following the Parker and Longoria scandal, Benavides became a prosecutor in Texas. (Parker and Longoria are pictured above in October 2010.) Getty Images 
 Following the scandal, Benavides switched careers and served as a prosecutor in Texas. She also worked with organizations that supported vulnerable children.
 Benavides worked with the 38th Judicial District, and ultimately resigned from her role in August 2026.
 TMZ was first to publish the autopsy and toxicology results.
 If you or someone you know is affected by any of the issues raised in this story, call the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 800-273-TALK (8255) or text Crisis Text Line at 741741. 
 If you are struggling with suicidal thoughts, you can dial the 24/7 National Suicide Prevention Hotline at 988 or go to SuicidePreventionLifeline.org .
